functions.name: Card.GetSummonLocation
description_zh: 返回c的召唤/特殊召唤的位置
description_en: Returns the call position of c

functions.name: Card.GetSummonPlayer

functions.name: Card.GetSummonType

functions.name: Card.GetSynchroType
description_zh: 返回c用作同调素材时的类型（与GetType的区别在于对于魔陷区的怪兽卡，返回其原本类型）
description_en: Return the type of card c when used as Synchro Material (unlike GetType, for monster cards in the Spell/Trap Zone, it returns their original type)

description_zh: 返回c的卡片记载的攻击力，返回值是负数表示是"?"
description_en: Returns the attack power recorded on card c

functions.name: Card.GetTextDefense
description_zh: 返回c的卡片记载的守备力，返回值是负数表示是"?"
description_en: Return the c 's card record of the garrison

functions.name: Card.GetTributeRequirement
description_zh: 返回通常召唤c所需要的祭品的最小和最大数量
description_en: Returns the minimum and maximum number of sacrifices required to normally call c

functions.name: Card.GetTunerLimit
description_zh: 如果卡片 c 受到同调素材限制效果 EFFECT_TUNER_MATERIAL_LIMIT 影响，则返回 Effect e,function target,int value,int min,int max ;否则返回nil

functions.name: Card.IsAbleToChangeControler

description_en: Check whether c can change the control
Note: This function returns false only if the card receives the effect of "Can not change control"

functions.name: Card.IsAbleToDeck
description_zh: 检查c是否可以送去卡组
description_en: Checks whether c can be returned to the Deck.

functions.name: Card.IsAbleToDeckAsCost
description_zh: 检查c是否可以作为cost送去卡组

description_en: Checks whether c can be returned to the Deck or Extra Deck as a cost.

functions.name: Card.IsAbleToExtra
description_zh: 检查c是否可以送去额外卡组
对于非融合、同调等额外怪兽或者非灵摆怪兽此函数均返回false
description_en: Check if c can send extra cards
This function returns false for non-fusion, cohomology, and overdrive cards

description_zh: 检查c是否可以作为cost送去额外卡组，主卡组的灵摆卡会返回false
description_en: Checks whether c can be returned to the Extra Deck as a cost.

functions.name: Card.IsAbleToGrave
description_zh: 检查c是否可以送去墓地
description_en: Checks whether c can be sent to the Graveyard.

functions.name: Card.IsAbleToGraveAsCost
description_zh: 检查c是否可以作为cost送去墓地

functions.name: Card.IsAbleToHand
description_zh: 检查c是否可以送去手卡

当c送往手卡会被送去其它地方时（如缩退回路适用中，或者c是融合、同调 等额外怪兽的一种），此函数返回false

description_en: Checks whether c includes all types in type.

description_en: Check if card c's ATK is atk1 [, or atk2...], returns false if c is not a monster card or not in LOCATION_MZONE

Cards that are already negated, have no original effects, or are unaffected by e cannot be negated.
The optional third parameter indicates whether this is a monster effect.

description_en: Check whether c can be the object of effect e

description_en: Check if c can be used as Link Material [for Link Monster sc]; if sc is not specified, must pass nil

Returns false if the target player is invalid, c is forbidden, or placing c there would violate uniqueness checks.

description_en: Checks whether c can be used as Ritual Material for sc; pass nil when no Ritual Monster is being checked.

functions.name: Card.IsCanBeSpecialSummoned
description_zh: 检查c是否可以被玩家sumplayer用效果e[以sumtype方式和sumpos表示形式]特殊召唤[到玩家 toplayer 的区域zone]
如果nocheck是true则不检查c的召唤条件，如果nolimit是true则不检查c的苏生限制

functions.name: Group.CheckWithSumEqual
description_zh: 子集求和判定函数，f为返回一个interger值的函数
检查g中是否存在一个数量为min-max的子集满足以f对子集的每一个元素求值的和等于sum，从第6个参数开始为额外参数
比如：g:CheckWithSumEqual(Card.GetSynchroLevel,7,2,99)
检查g中是否存在一个子集满足子集的同调用等级之和等于7
description_en: The subset summation decision function, f, is a function that returns an interger value
Check whether there is a subset of min-max in g that satisfies that the sum of the values ​​of each element of the subset f is equal to sum, starting at the 6th argument as an extra parameter
For example: g: CheckWithSumEqual (Card.GetSynchroLevel, 7,2,99)
Check if the sum of the same call levels in a subset of g satisfies a subset equal to 7

functions.name: Group.CheckWithSumGreater
description_zh: 子集求和判定函数之二，f为返回一个interger值的函数
检查g中是否存在一个子集满足以f对子集的每一个元素求值的和刚好大于或者等于sum，从第4个参数开始为额外参数
比如：g:CheckWithSumGreater(Card.GetRitualLevel,8)
检查g中是否存在一个子集满足子集的仪式用等级之和大于等于8
注：判定必须是“刚好”大于或者等于
以等级为例，要使等级合计大于等于8，可以选择LV1+LV7而不可以选择LV1+LV4+LV4
description_en: The sum of the subsets is determined by a function f, which is a function that returns an interger value

Check that there is a subset in g that satisfies that the sum of the values ​​of each element of the subset f is just greater than or equal to sum, starting at the fourth argument as an extra parameter
For example: g: CheckWithSumGreater (Card.GetRitualLevel, 8)
Check if the sum of the ritual classes in g satisfies a subset of 8 or greater
Note: The decision must be "just" greater than or equal to
To grade, for example, to make the total level is greater than or equal to 8, you can choose LV1 + LV7 and can not choose LV1 + LV4 + LV4

description_en: Simplified method for the condition of player tp taking damage, used in effect registration for SetCondition
function aux.damcon1(e, tp, eg, ep, ev, re, r, rp)
local e1=Duel.IsPlayerAffectedByEffect(tp, EFFECT_REVERSE_DAMAGE)
local e2=Duel.IsPlayerAffectedByEffect(tp, EFFECT_REVERSE_RECOVER)
local rd=e1 and not e2
local rr=not e1 and e2
local ex,cg,ct,cp,cv=Duel.GetOperationInfo(ev, CATEGORY_DAMAGE)
if ex and (cp==tp or cp==PLAYER_ALL) and not rd and not Duel.IsPlayerAffectedByEffect(tp, EFFECT_NO_EFFECT_DAMAGE) then
return true
end
ex,cg,ct,cp,cv=Duel.GetOperationInfo(ev, CATEGORY_RECOVER)
return ex and (cp==tp or cp==PLAYER_ALL) and rr and not Duel.IsPlayerAffectedByEffect(tp, EFFECT_NO_EFFECT_DAMAGE)
end
